_comment: Example scenario: a walk through the UI kit gallery of the generated web app (web/app/kit/page.tsx). Copy it for a feature's sign-off walk: one file per scenario, a caption per step saying what the user does and sees, and at least one expectation per step. Format: lib/scenario.ts. Run: npm run uat -- --base-url <url> --scenario 01-kit-gallery
title: Browse the UI kit gallery

steps.caption: Open the UI kit gallery: the page title and the sample table are shown
Go to the next page of the table: rows 11 to 20 are shown
Open the drawer: the sample item's panel slides in
Save in the drawer: the panel closes and a confirmation appears
Open the empty states tab: the empty list message is shown
